description: This header file declares the APIs and structures for managing TR-069 device IP download diagnostics, specifically for the DownloadDiagnostics object, including setters for various diagnostic parameters and configuration.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Sets the DiagnosticsState parameter indicating diagnostic test status and control (e.g., Requested, Completed, Error).

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_Interface
methods.description: Configures the IP layer interface over which diagnostics are performed.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DownloadURL
methods.description: Sets the URL from which the CPE will perform the download test (HTTP or FTP).

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_EthernetPriority
methods.description: Configures the ethernet priority code used during tests.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DSCP
methods.description: Configures the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) for marking packets during tests.
